entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: A large forest island off Terisiare, home to elves and druids, obliterated by the Sylex Blast at the end of the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Activated the Golgothian Sylex, obliterating Argoth.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Brother of Urza whose drained army moved operations to Argoth.

entities.name: Harbin
entities.description: Urza's son who discovered Argoth by landing there in a storm.

entities.name: Titania
entities.description: Ruler of Argoth, killed amid the Brothers' combat.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Turned the Creeping Mold of Argoth into a plague during his exile and kidnapped the elves' priestess.

entities.name: Elyssendril Lademmdrith
entities.description: Elf priestess kidnapped by Yawgmoth; she survived and joined the delegates to Halcyon.

entities.name: Citanul
entities.description: Settlement at the center of Argoth where druids and Titania lived.

entities.name: Gaea's Cradle
entities.description: Legendary place from where Argoth was said to have begun growing.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: Explosion of the Golgothian Sylex that nearly wiped Argoth from the map and threw Dominaria into an Ice Age.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: Artifact Urza activated to end the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: War between Urza and Mishra, fought over Argoth near its end.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: Place whose location relative to Argoth is disputed.

events.summary: During his exile, Yawgmoth turns Argoth's Creeping Mold into a plague and kidnaps the elven priestess Elyssendril, ransoming her for sweetened water and dead healers.
events.quote: he delivered to them only sweetened water and twelve dead healers

events.summary: Harbin discovers Argoth; Urza's and Mishra's armies move in and deplete its forests.
events.quote: Before long, the island's forests were nearly depleted by the two war machines.

events.summary: Titania is killed amid the brothers' combat.
events.quote: Titania was eventually killed amid their combat.

events.summary: The Sylex Blast nearly wipes Argoth from the map and throws Dominaria into an Ice Age.
events.quote: threw Dominaria into an Ice Age

events.summary: The few surviving elves eke out an existence until migrating to Fyndhorn centuries later.
events.quote: The few remaining elves eked out a meager existence, until migrating to Fyndhorn many centuries later.

relations.quote: when Urza activated the Golgothian Sylex
